items.title: Flip Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: We had a good rhythm section there. Jo Jones, Hank Jones, Ray Brown.

ctx.x: Well they did record one particular night, where you played the solo on “Perdido” which has followed you around.

Yeah that was a good one. That came off, we had a concert at, not the Island, the Mosque Theater in Newark at eight o’clock, and at twelve o’clock we went to Carnegie Hall in New York, and that’s when it was made, in 1947. We played it and everybody was relaxed and it just came off. It was wonderful you know at the time, and we didn’t think anything of it. And then when the record — all the disc jockeys started playing it. And it was quite a thing. It sold a million albums. For an instrumental, that’s great. And…
How can you go wrong with those guys behind you?
